revision_note: Before candidate construction, the atom-count strata were replaced by 16 training-pool quantile bins after the complete training-visible measurement identified a 1--192 atom range and the original eight bins missed the 3% cost-matching gate. No candidate membership or external outcome had been inspected.
scientific_question: Can measurements under a pretrained phonon model choose a fixed-size DFT post-training set before candidate training outcomes are observed?

signal_definition.name: singleton_objective_signal
signal_definition.class_balance: computed once over all 7809 eligible records
signal_definition.exclusion_reason: The released ranking terms are defined over sampled pairs and have no unique per-structure attribution.

coverage_definition.representation: 256-dimensional graph_h output of the frozen pretrained encoder
coverage_definition.preprocessing: center on the eligible pool, full deterministic SVD, retain the first 32 principal components, divide each retained component by its nonzero singular-value scale, then L2-normalize each record
coverage_definition.distance: Euclidean distance in the normalized 32-dimensional representation

candidate_construction.stratum_quotas: largest-remainder allocation proportional to the eligible-pool stratum counts at each budget

rules.hash_uniform: ascending deterministic hash within atom-count stratum
rules.signal: descending singleton objective signal within atom-count stratum
rules.coverage: greedy farthest-first representation coverage subject to remaining stratum quotas; initialize with the record nearest the eligible-pool centroid
rules.signal_coverage: greedy maximum of 0.5 * eligible-pool signal percentile + 0.5 * normalized distance to the selected set, subject to remaining stratum quotas; initialize with the highest combined signal percentile and centroid distance

training.checkpoint_validation: all 411 released checkpoint-validation records, unchanged across arms
training.checkpoint_rule: minimum total loss on the common internal checkpoint-validation set
training.loss_contract: released PhononScore DFT post-training objective and weights

evaluation.open_gate: all expected arm-budget-seed checkpoints and compact prediction outputs pass identity and completeness audits

permitted_before_candidate_freeze: starting-model measurements on eligible training records
